entries.what: Jun opened Heron & Grind at 6:15, pulled Wes Arnaud's 7 a.m. cortado and poured a swan for a regular.
entries.outcome: Wes paid in quarters and left a decent tip.

entries.what: After clocking out at 2:30, Jun bought wrappers at Ruiz Family Market and rolled a test batch at Tess's kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Tess critiqued the filling but still listed orders on the fridge.

entries.what: Jun checked his savings and the receipt pile in the evening, then went to bed early for the next opener.
entries.outcome: Decided to deal with the numbers later.

entries.what: Opening shift at the cafe; Jun showed Linh how to texture milk for a tulip pour.
entries.outcome: Linh got a passable tulip on her third try.

entries.what: On his break Jun texted Paolo about prepping for Saturday's counter sales.
entries.outcome: Paolo said he could only do late prep because of his closing line shifts.

entries.what: Evening at home, Jun played OPM ballads and folded wrappers with Tess.
entries.outcome: Prepped about 50 lumpia for freezing.

entries.what: Jun called Joan Whitaker at the Ruel Road commissary and booked a standing Friday 5-9 p.m. block instead of ad hoc hours.
entries.outcome: Block confirmed, starting this Friday; he reread Joan's fryer rule.
entries.feeling: excited, a little nervous about cost

entries.what: Worked the morning shift at the cafe, then filled up at the Ruel Road station on the way home.
entries.outcome: Gas was cheaper again, as always.

entries.what: Jun told Tess about the commissary block over dinner on her day off.
entries.outcome: Tess said nothing about the cost, only asked who would cook.

entries.what: Cafe opener; Beatrice's corgi Ledger wandered the floor while Jun ran the morning rush.
entries.outcome: Sam texted to swap Saturday and Jun said no.

entries.what: Afternoon at the Lola's Roll Instagram plan; Jun and Paolo traded captions by phone.
entries.outcome: Paolo posted a teaser photo; followers inched up.

entries.what: Jun bought pork and shrimp for Friday's batch and charged his dying phone at the counter.
entries.outcome: Shopping done, phone at 20% by evening.

entries.what: Last cafe shift of the week ended at 2:30 and Jun napped before the commissary.
entries.outcome: Got ninety minutes of sleep.

entries.what: First standing Friday block at Ruel Road commissary; Jun rolled and fried batches while scrubbing the fryer area before time ran out.
entries.outcome: Beat Joan's fryer rule and avoided the $40 fee; Paolo arrived late after his shift prep.

entries.what: Late dinner of al pastor at Taquería Colima after packing the cooler.
entries.outcome: Fed and ready for Saturday.

entries.what: Saturday table at Heron & Grind: Jun sold lumpia from the end of the counter during his shift.
entries.outcome: Sold out of the batch; Wes bought his two for quarters.

entries.what: Jun tried to total September ingredients from a pile of crumpled receipts and asked the assistant if he could just guess the number.
entries.outcome: Still without a total; the shoebox stays a mess.

entries.what: Evening dishes and prep at Tess's house, and a quick text to Paolo about Sunday's market visit.
entries.outcome: Plan set to walk the market early.

entries.what: Jun went to the Delgado Park harvest market early, skipping pickup basketball, and found Rick Dominguez walking the lot.
entries.outcome: Got added to the waitlist for a Sunday slot.

entries.what: Wandered the market stalls tasting tamales and looking at how vendors set up.
entries.outcome: Took notes on stall layouts and fees.

entries.what: Sunday dinner at Tess's after mass; she sampled a lumpia and went back to her list of coworker orders.
entries.outcome: No verdict on onion this time.
